processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Yahya ibn Sa'id: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said about a milk-camel to be milked: 'Who will milk this one?' processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Yahya ibn Sa'id: Umar ibn al-Khattab said to a man: 'What is your name?' He said: 'Jamrah (Ember).' He said: 'Son of whom?' And it was as Umar said.

processed_hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِك أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ أَرَادَ الْخُرُوجَ إِلَى الْعِرَاقِ ، فَقَالَ لَهُ كَعْبُ الْأَحْبَارِ : " لَا تَخْرُجْ إِلَيْهَا يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ، فَإِنَّ بِهَا تِسْعَةَ أَعْشَارِ السِّحْرِ ، وَبِهَا فَسَقَةُ الْجِنِّ ، وَبِهَا الدَّاءُ الْعُضَالُ "
processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Malik: It reached him that Umar ibn al-Khattab intended to go out to Iraq, and Ka'b al-Ahbar said to him: 'Do not go there, O Commander of the Faithful, for in it are nine-tenths of magic, in it are the wicked jinn, and in it is the incurable disease.'

narrators.name: Malik
narrators.full_name: Malik ibn Anas ibn Malik ibn Abi Amir al-Asbahi
reliabilityIssues: This is a balagh (بَلَغَهُ) - Malik reports it without mentioning any chain of narrators

narrators.name: Umar ibn al-Khattab
narrators.full_name: Umar ibn al-Khattab ibn Nufayl al-Adawi al-Qurashi

narrators.name: Ka'b al-Ahbar
narrators.full_name: Ka'b ibn Mati' al-Himyari al-Yamani
reliabilityIssues: Known for Isra'iliyyat (narrations from Jewish sources)

chainIssues: Complete disconnection - this is a balagh report where Malik doesn't mention any chain between himself and the incident

plainChains: Malik ibn Anas -> (Unknown chain) -> Ka'b al-Ahbar & Umar ibn al-Khattab (Balagh)

potential_issues.issue: This is a balagh (بَلَغَهُ) report - Malik states 'it reached me' without providing any chain of narrators
potential_issues.impact: Severe - Balagh reports are among the weakest forms of transmission as the entire chain is missing. We don't know who narrated this to Malik

potential_issues.issue: The statement is attributed to Ka'b al-Ahbar, who was known for transmitting Isra'iliyyat (Jewish traditions)
potential_issues.impact: This is not a prophetic hadith but rather a statement from Ka'b al-Ahbar, which may be based on previous scriptures rather than Islamic sources
